text: {"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"NJ","level":"state","category":"screening_restrictions","status":"in_force","title":"Fair Chance in Housing Act (criminal record screening limits)","requirement":"Housing providers may not ask about or require applications to include criminal record inquiries before making a conditional offer, except for methamphetamine manufacture convictions on the premises of federally assisted housing and lifetime sex offender registration. Before or after a conditional offer, they may not evaluate applicants on arrests or charges without conviction, expunged, pardoned, vacated or sealed records, or juvenile adjudications. After a conditional offer, only certain convictions may be considered: murder, aggravated sexual assault, kidnapping, arson, human trafficking, and other listed offenses or any crime resulting in lifetime sex offender registration; first-degree indictable offenses within 6 years; second- or third-degree within 4 years; fourth-degree within 1 year (measured from conviction or the end of a prison sentence). A conditional offer may be withdrawn only if withdrawal is necessary to fulfill a substantial, legitimate and nondiscriminatory interest, shown by a preponderance of the evidence, after an individualized assessment of listed factors. The provider must give written notice of the specific reasons and an opportunity to appeal. The applicant may request the information relied on within 30 days, and the provider must supply it free within 10 days. Before accepting any application fee, the provider must disclose in writing whether criminal history is considered and that the applicant may submit evidence of inaccuracies or rehabilitation. Providers may not require drug or alcohol tests or consent to obtain drug treatment facility information. Advertisements stating that applicants with arrests or convictions will not be considered are prohibited. Criminal records may not be shared with, or used for, purposes inconsistent with the act.","key_value":"Look-back after conditional offer: 6 years (1st degree), 4 years (2nd/3rd degree), 1 year (4th degree); no criminal inquiry before a conditional offer; 30-day request / 10-day response for information relied on","coverage_conditions":"Applies to housing providers offering a rental dwelling unit for residential purposes.","exemptions":"Excludes a dwelling unit in an owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.","coverage_logic":{"covers":null,"exempt":{"all":[{"field":"owner_occupied","op":"==","value":true},{"field":"units","op":"<=","value":4}]}},"subject":"landlord","interaction":"Does not bar other rights or actions that exist independently, including under the Law Against Discrimination (P.L.1945, c.169). Actions alleging violations of this act may not be initiated in court; complaints go to the Division on Civil Rights.","yields_to_local":false,"preempts_local":false,"effective_date":"2022-01-01","effective_rule":{"type":"first_day_of_nth_month_after","n":7,"enacted":"2021-06-18"},"enacted_date":"2021-06-18","end_date":null,"penalty":"Civil penalty up to $1,000 for a first violation, up to $5,000 with one prior violation in 5 years, up to $10,000 with two or more prior violations in 7 years; the director may also order cease and desist, return of the application fee, payment of up to $1,000 to the applicant, and in some cases remedy of the violation.","citation":"P.L.2021, c.110 (N.J.S.A. 46:8-52 et seq.)","quoted_span":"A housing provider shall not make any oral or written inquiry regarding an applicant’s criminal record prior to making a conditional offer.","supporting_spans":["This act shall take effect on the first day of the seventh month next following the date of enactment,","“Rental dwelling unit” means a dwelling unit offered for rent by a housing provider for residential purposes, other than a dwelling unit in an owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units."],"confidence":0.95,"conflict_note":null}],"notes":"Only one in-scope rule: the NJ Fair Chance in Housing Act, a screening restriction. Effective date computed as the first day of the 7th month after approval on 2021-06-18, giving 2022-01-01.
